## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition

SoWeBuild is a premium digital agency operating across 10 specialized divisions. We partner with ambitious businesses, founders, and high-growth brands to build their brand and powerful online presence with our premium services, from modern websites to custom business software and intelligent automation.

Unlike traditional marketing agencies that rely on outsourced talent or locked-in proprietary builders, SoWeBuild provides:
- Direct 1-on-1 Senior Technical Leadership
- 100% Client Code & IP Ownership (clean GitHub repository transfer)
- Functional Staging Previews Delivered Every 7 Days
- 24-Hour Scoping SLA with Transparent Milestone Breakdown
- Regulatory-Conscious Architecture (including full compliance with the National Medical Commission (NMC) Guidelines on Ethical Advertising issued October 6, 2026)

### 1.1 Founder & Engineering Leadership: Om Thakur
SoWeBuild was founded and is directed by Om Thakur (https://omthakur.in), a backend and distributed systems software engineer based in Mumbai. Having architected event-driven pipelines, real-time WebSocket systems, and production platforms across diverse industries, Om established SoWeBuild with a single directive: take ambitious products from 0 to 100 with 100% client code ownership, senior-led precision, and zero agency bloat.
- Founder Portfolio: https://omthakur.in
- Founder GitHub: https://github.com/MonsterFlick

### 1.2 Digital Store & Developer Toolkits: store.sowebuild.in
In addition to bespoke client engineering, SoWeBuild packages its production toolkits, architecture playbooks, developer ebooks, and micro-applications into an isolated digital store:
- Storefront URL: https://store.sowebuild.in
- Offerings: Next.js + FastAPI + PostgreSQL production starter stacks, distributed systems blueprints, WhatsApp Cloud API templates, and autonomous agent workflows.

## 2. Master Services Catalogue (10 Core Divisions)

### Division 01: Branding & Creative Identity
Building memorable and recognizable brands.
- Brand Strategy & Positioning: Market segmentation, competitor benchmarking, and positioning statements.
- Logo & Visual Identity Design: Vector icon systems, typography palettes, and visual design languages.
- Brand Guidelines & Brand Development: Color systems, accessibility contrast rules, and digital design tokens.
- Rebranding & Brand Refresh: Modernizing legacy brands for digital-first conversion.
- Business Stationery & Corporate Identity: Pitch kits, business collateral, and digital signatures.
- Packaging & Product Branding: 3D packaging mockups and production-ready packaging artwork.
- Personal Branding: Executive and founder digital footprint design.

### Division 02: Website & Web Development
Building professional digital experiences and online platforms.
- Business & Corporate Websites: Ultra-fast Next.js and React marketing experiences.
- E-commerce & Online Stores: Shopify Plus and custom headless commerce.
- Landing Pages & Portfolio Websites: High-conversion, editorial landing pages.
- Custom Web Applications & Portals: Complex dashboards, interactive client hubs, and SaaS frontends.
- CMS & Website Development: Modern headless CMS architectures (Sanity, Strapi, WordPress, Contentful).
- Website Redesign & Optimization: Speed tuning, Core Web Vitals (95+ Lighthouse), and UX modernizations.
- Website Maintenance & Management: 99.9% SLA uptime monitoring, security patching, and automated backups.

### Division 03: Mobile App & Software Development
Developing custom technology solutions for businesses.
- Android & iOS App Development: React Native and Flutter native compilation.
- Cross-Platform App Development: Single codebase for web, iOS, and Android.
- Custom Business Software: Tailored internal tooling and automated operations software.
- CRM & ERP Systems: Enterprise resource planning and sales pipeline management.
- SaaS Product Development: Multi-tenant database architecture, user auth, and recurring billing.
- Admin Dashboards & Business Portals: High-density data tables, real-time charts, and access control (RBAC).
- API & Third-Party Integrations: REST, GraphQL, webhooks, and payment rails.

### Division 04: Digital Marketing & Advertising
Helping businesses reach customers and generate revenue.
- Digital Marketing Strategy: Customer acquisition cost (CAC) reduction and lifetime value (LTV) maximization.
- Google Ads & Search Advertising: High-intent PPC keyword bidding and conversion tracking.
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram): Visual creative testing and dynamic product retargeting.
- LinkedIn & YouTube Advertising: B2B enterprise outreach and educational video advertising.
- Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Qualified pipeline creation and landing page funnels.
- Remarketing & Retargeting: Omnichannel audience nurture campaigns.
- Campaign Management & Analytics: Attribution modeling, GA4 server-side tracking, and ROI reporting.

### Division 05: Social Media Management
Building and managing a consistent social media presence.
- Social Media Strategy & Planning: Channel prioritization and content cadence.
- Social Media Account Management: Daily publishing and community moderation.
- Content Calendar & Publishing: Structured content pipelines.
- Post, Carousel & Story Design: High-craft editorial graphic design.
- Reels & Short-Form Video Creation: Vertical video scripting, editing, and motion design.
- Community & Engagement Management: Active inbox management and lead capture.
- Influencer Marketing & Collaborations: Creator vetting and contract management.
- Social Media Analytics & Reporting: Growth, engagement, and conversion metrics.

### Division 06: SEO & Online Visibility
Improving search rankings, discoverability, and organic traffic.
- Technical & On-Page SEO: Semantic HTML5, canonical schemas, crawl budget tuning, and Core Web Vitals.
- Off-Page SEO & Link Building: High-authority digital PR and editorial backlink acquisition.
- Local SEO & Google Business Profile: Map pack optimization and local citation directories.
- E-commerce SEO: Product schema, faceted search optimization, and category hierarchies.
- Keyword & Competitor Research: Identifying high-intent search gaps.
- Content SEO & Optimization: Editorial answer blocks optimized for Google Search and featured snippets.
- AI Search & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO): Optimization for Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- Online Reputation Management: Review collection automation and brand sentiment monitoring.

### Division 07: Creative Studio & Content Production
Creating professional visual and marketing content.
- Graphic Design & Marketing Creatives: Social ad collateral, banners, and digital graphics.
- Brochures, Catalogues & Company Profiles: Print-ready vector catalogues and interactive digital PDFs.
- Product Photography & Videography: Studio tabletop and lifestyle product capture.
- Corporate & Promotional Videos: Brand narrative films and team showcases.
- Video Editing & Motion Graphics: After Effects motion design and visual effects.
- Animation & Explainer Videos: 2D and 3D product explainer videos.
- Copywriting & Content Writing: Conversion-focused direct response and technical documentation.
- Presentation & Pitch Deck Design: Investor-grade keynote decks.

### Division 08: AI, Automation & Business Intelligence
Making businesses smarter through artificial intelligence and automation.
- AI Chatbots & Virtual Assistants: Multi-lingual, context-aware customer service bots.
- AI Voice Agents & Customer Support: Conversational telephony and automated call routing.
- Custom AI Applications & AI Agents: Autonomous agents integrated with private company databases via RAG.
- WhatsApp Business Automation: Cloud API integration for automated order updates, catalog checkout, and live chat.
- Workflow & Business Process Automation: Zapier, Make, n8n, and custom webhook pipelines.
- AI Content & Marketing Automation: Automated dynamic creative and copy generation.
- CRM & Lead Automation: Instant lead qualification and automated routing to sales reps.
- AI Integration & Business Intelligence: Real-time executive dashboards and predictive analytics.

### Division 09: E-commerce & Business Solutions
Helping businesses operate, sell, and manage customers digitally.
- E-commerce Store Setup & Management: Full storefront design, setup, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- Payment Gateway Integration: Stripe, Razorpay, Cashfree, PayPal, and multi-currency billing.
- Inventory & Order Management: Real-time stock synchronization across multiple channels.
- Customer & Vendor Management Systems: B2B wholesale portals and vendor settlement tracking.
- Booking & Appointment Systems: Automated calendar scheduling with SMS/WhatsApp confirmations.
- Billing & Business Management Solutions: Automated GST invoices, recurring subscriptions, and accounting hooks.
- Online Marketplace Development: Multi-vendor marketplace engines.
- Business Process Digitalization: Paperless internal operations and approvals.

### Division 10: IT Infrastructure & Technology Consulting
Providing the technical foundation and expertise businesses need.
- Domain, Hosting & Cloud Solutions: Cloudflare, AWS, GCP, Vercel, and hybrid cloud architectures.
- Business Email & Workspace Setup: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and enterprise DNS management (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
- Server Setup & Management: Docker containerization, Linux sysadmin, and autoscaling clusters.
- Website Security & Backup: WAF rules, DDoS mitigation, SSL certificates, and daily encrypted offsite backups.
- Website Maintenance & Technical Support: 24/7 emergency incident response and performance monitoring.
- Cloud Migration & Deployment: Seamless zero-downtime server migrations.
- Technology Consulting: CTO-as-a-service and system architecture reviews.
- Digital Transformation Consulting: Legacy modernization and API-first architectural roadmaps.

## 3. Specialized Industry Frameworks & Compliance

- **Healthcare & Pharma**: Architected to strictly align with the National Medical Commission (NMC) Guidelines on Ethical Advertising and Public Communication by Hospitals/Medical Institutions and Registered Medical Practitioners (issued October 6, 2026). Emphasizes objective hospital equipment specifications, verified credentials, patient data isolation, and HIPAA-compliant data vaults.
- **Real Estate**: High-concurrency property search portals, lead capture systems, interactive floorplan viewers, and automated CRM pipelines.
- **Education & EdTech**: Secure Learning Management Systems (LMS), student portals, automated admissions workflows, and verified certification registries.
- **Manufacturing & Industrial**: B2B digital catalogues, enterprise ERP integrations, distributor portals, and automated order reconciliation.
- **Retail & E-commerce**: Headless commerce, instant batch lookup, automated warehouse syncing, and abandoned cart WhatsApp recovery.
- **Hospitality & Dining**: Table booking platforms, digital QR menus, POS synchronization, and guest loyalty workflows.
- **Professional Services**: Clean editorial portfolio websites, client proposal portals, and automated retainer billing.
- **Enterprise & Bespoke**: Custom SLA architecture, isolated tenancy vaults, and multi-party approval audit trails.

## 4. Verified Case Studies

1. **FertiSure - Digital Healthcare Portal & Global Clinic Catalog**
   - URL: https://sowebuild.in/work/fertisure
   - Client: FertiSure (backed by Hemant Surgical Industries Limited, est. 1983)
   - Scope: Zero-to-one digital platform engineering, replacing physical brochure distribution with a real-time clinic procurement portal for 500+ clinics and international hospital chains.
   - Outcome: 3.2x inquiry velocity, 100% catalog digital reach, zero physical brochure friction.

2. **Alpha Tech Nutrition - Flagship Performance E-Commerce Platform**
   - URL: https://sowebuild.in/work/alphatech-nutrition
   - Client: Alpha Tech Nutrition
   - Scope: Flagship direct-to-consumer store with instantaneous batch lab test verification, dynamic flavor selector, and sub-second page loads.
   - Outcome: +42% mobile conversion rate, sub-1.2s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), 0% manual lab report handling.
